coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to complete PKGBUILD review due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving PKGBUILD marked inconclusive
learnings: API failures during audit should be clearly distinguished from security findings - they represent tool issues, not package risks
When one report fails due to tool error and another succeeds with clean findings, the successful report should carry the verdict rather than forcing inconclusive
Binary packages (-bin) from official upstream sources with pinned checksums are low-risk and should be quickly cleared when no injection patterns are present
